method: Typed C migration of the native default-slot wrapper, with its byte result established by the caller's use of AL and the prior project's matching typed body.

groups.previous_source_notes: The prior typed body returns the default-slot load result but uses LegacyBindings; it was only a cross-check.

verification.reason: The native body forwards the name and -1 slot index; the byte result is live in AL in callers at 0x0053DD10 and 0x0053DD40.
